summary:
Implemented `py:type` and `:py:type:` using `PyObject` registration and lookup, with optional annotation parsing, canonical alias registration, nested index text, and documentation. Added regression coverage for signatures, indexing, nesting, and module/class cross-reference resolution.

All Python-domain tests passed: 92 passed. `git diff --check` passed. Only the Python-domain test files were run; pytest reported an unrelated LibreSSL/urllib3 warning.
